text:
maria_sales: Heads-up: SwissBank wants a 2-week POC that keeps processing + storage inside Switzerland only. They want sub-processor names, DPA language, and a rough pricing delta.

sanjay_engineering: Hosted API can't guarantee CH physical locality today. Two routes: Dedicated with tenant-pin + region affinity (best-effort CH) or Private/on-prem via a local partner (we used HelveticCloud before). BYOK/HSM is commonly requested.

sanjay_engineering: Draft routing policy for POC: `{"routing_policy":"tenant_pin","preferred_region":"ch-central","strict_residency":true,"failover":"no_fallback"}` -- enforces pin and disables cross-region failover.

maria_sales: Procurement wants a ballpark delta vs eu-central to budget.

sanjay_engineering: Preliminary ballpark: Dedicated CH = +20-40% infra premium vs eu-central (regional pool sizing + licensing). BYOK/HSM adds ~+30% (integration + HSM monthly). Private/on-prem POC with HelveticCloud est ~USD 15k-25k/month depending on instance/KMS. Can firm numbers in 48h after ops sizing.

claire_legal: They asked for subprocessor list, DPA text (data transfer basis), and certifications. Schrems II flagged; want to know if control-plane metadata leaves CH.

noah_sre: Control-plane for Hosted/Dedicated currently in EU; for POC we can minimise telemetry. Private via HelveticCloud allows control-plane hosted in customer VPC (no CH egress). Preview subprocessors for CH deploy: HelveticCloud (hosting), CloudNetCH (network), Redwood-support (ops). I'll prepare a redacted subproc list + attestation.

ops_bot: ticket created #POC-CH-789 assigned @sanjay_engineering @noah_sre. Target: quote + subproc list in 48h :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

maria_sales: Great. I'll confirm with customer whether BYOK/HSM is mandatory and loop back. Please attach DPA snippet and subproc link when ready.

sanjay_engineering: Preview link: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors/ch and sample DPA line: `Data processing and storage for the tenant will be located in Switzerland. Control-plane telemetry will be minimised; customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) required if requested.` Will DM full legal export and formal quote after ops sizing.

maria_sales: Thanks — updating the customer. If they insist on immediate Private deploy I'll escalate to solutions. :thumbsup:
